title: San Siro, Anfield & Co. - Every 2025/26 Champions League stadium ranked by capacity | Transfermarkt
content: With this in mind, *Transfermarkt* has ranked every stadium set to host Champions League fixtures in 2025/26 by size, offering a snapshot of where the drama will unfold and which grounds will welcome the largest - but not necessarily loudest - crowds under the floodlights, as well as which clubs will be trying to upset the odds with a small following behind them. Third goes to the historic San Siro, which will only see Inter Milan host games there in this term's Champions League with AC Milan not qualified - that stadium has a capacity of 75,923. At the other end of the scale, let's take a look at the smallest stadiums in this season's edition of the Champions League, with four grounds having a capacity of less than 10,000. The smallest of which would be Qarabag's Azersun Arena, which has a capacity of just 5,800, but they are playing their Champions League gams at the Azerbaijan National team stadium, the Tofiq Bahremov Republican Stadium, which has a capacity of 32,000.
